sources.title: whisper-tiny: Audio-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The model reflects OpenAI's 2022 training snapshot. The newer whisper-large-v2 has superseded this variant for quality-critical applications, and the tiny model receives no updates for new languages, improved accuracy, or architectural improvements. Apache 2.0 license permits commercial use but without liability guarantees.
